svg.title: Warehouse racking
svg.desc: A warehouse aisle in front of a back wall with a roll-up door: five bays of three-level pallet racking loaded with carton stacks, stretch-wrapped loads and drums, one slot left empty. A forklift with an overhead guard waits in the aisle and raises the lit pallet up to the empty slot. A hand pallet jack with cartons and a stack of empty pallets stand on the marked floor.
